scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build:apps
scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w @hivemap/graph-core && npm run build -w @hivemap/categories && npm run build -w @hivemap/capture && npm run build -w @hivemap/projections && npm run build -w @hivemap/scans && npm run build -w @hivemap/storage && npm run build -w @hivemap/api-contracts && npm run build -w @hivemap/runtime
scripts.build:apps: npm run build -w @hivemap/mcp && npm run build -w @hivemap/api && npm run build -w @hivemap/web
scripts.dev:api: npm run build && npm exec -w @hivemap/api -- hivemap-api
scripts.test: npm run build:packages && npm run test:workspaces
scripts.verify: npm run build && npm run typecheck && npm run test:container-scripts && npm run test:workspaces
scripts.verify:acceptance: npm run verify && npm run verify:postgres && npm run verify:renders && npm exec -- playwright install chromium && npm run verify:image
